en: The postcard features a colorized view of a railway tunnel set in a lush, tree-filled area, with railway tracks running below a brick bridge. Above the tunnel, there is a fence, and in the background, one can see several buildings with red rooftops and a prominent church or town hall tower amidst mature trees. The image is captioned in the upper left with 'Kamenz I. S.' and in the upper right with 'Bahntunnel.' The sky is bright and partly cloudy.
